grades.one_line: Strong subject-specific storm and fishing imagery is undermined by a tiny decorative mascot and an empty, unreadable final payoff.
problems: Data is too small and mostly decorative instead of performing the statistic.
The closing text is too small and low-contrast on the fishing frames.
The final payoff collapses into a large dark void with no subject demonstration.
fixes: Give Data a clear action in the lightning or fishing setup that changes with the statistic.
Increase closing text size and contrast while retaining the boat/storm scene.
Hold the final illustrated scene through the payoff instead of fading to an empty dark frame.
